purpose: Provenance for conservative PID defaults on the measured-robot calibration; this is not a completed gain calibration or hardware-safety evidence.

validation.note: The values are conservative commissioning defaults. Run a fresh multi-seed gain search and held-out evaluation on this calibrated plant before making PID-versus-PRC performance claims.

artifact_compatibility.reason: Version 1 artifacts do not carry the required measured-robot calibration provenance and are rejected.

limitations: The provisional gains have not completed a multi-seed robustness sweep.
Simulation results are not hardware-safety evidence.
Reference frequencies above 0.1 Hz exceed the measured excitation envelope.
